title: Order Block vs Fair Value Gap: Which One Actually Gets You Funded in 2026?
description: Order blocks vs fair value gaps — traders argue about this every day. Here's what the R2F Trading system actually shows after 10+ years of data. One of these wins. Watch to find out which.

FVGs on the 15-minute model have a 68% fill rate in backtests. But FVGs alone miss context. No structure? No liquidity target? You're just guessing. One tool without the other is a half-strategy. The verdict? The R2F Trading system stacks both. Order block defines the zone. FVG inside it pinpoints the entry. That confluence is what funded traders use to pass in 2026. Follow R2F Trading.
